sla.ayarAciklama: Times are counted in business hours (Türkiye time). Weekends, nights and holidays are excluded.
sla.tatilIpucu: One date per line (YYYY-MM-DD). Religious holiday dates change every year; update them each January. For half days such as holiday eves, add "yarım" after the date (e.g. 2026-05-26 yarım): working hours end at 13:00.
sla.musteriNot: Times are counted within business hours; weekends and public holidays are excluded.
